answer: Latency triangulation stops sybils. Five beacons across continents ping each newcomer, timing round trips at their zenith into a fingerprint no two share. First, the agent answers a fresh nonce from each beacon within a second. Second, any vector matching an existing identity inside 3 ms is rejected. Third, a flagged identity must re-prove from a new network or stay frozen. One server running 1,000 clones yields 1,000 identical vectors, all rejected; spreading them costs $20,000 a month. Like a pearl around one grain, each epoch hardens it, and an onyx ledger keeps every vector public.
